title: Orb flies figure-eights over the Capitol for 45 minutes during a skywatch after the hearing

tellings.quote: and Anna Luna, right? And afterwards we went out and did a skywatch on the the um Library Congress, right? We were up on the platform and suddenly this orb appears and for 45 minutes it did figure8s over the cap in the white house.

plain: Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he draws UFOs to him and whom NASA has studied, says that in 2025, after a congressional hearing with Representative Anna Paulina Luna, his group held a skywatch from a platform at the Library of Congress and a glowing orb appeared and flew figure-eights over the Capitol and the White House for 45 minutes. He tells Michels he was there, and names others present, among them Representative Eric Burlison.
